instruction: Candid outdoor photograph, full shot. On an outdoor cobblestone path next to a rustic stone wall, the woman in the polka-dot dress (R2) on the left and the man in the brown fedora and white shirt (R1) on the right walk side-by-side to the left while holding hands. The man holds his silver saxophone in his left hand as they stroll. Natural daylight illuminates the scene, casting soft shadows on the ground and highlighting their happy expressions.
